approval_scope: Exact corrected two-pose concept, six source drawings and fourteen SMS PNGs in the request. Static proportion/equipment/body/material review; concept is truecolor, source palette and SMS palette have distinct scopes. One local source cutout defect prevents an unconditional source pass. No continuous perception, new owner acceptance, ROM or hardware approval.
conclusion: The proportion correction is visually coherent: the gun remains a long low dark navy/cyan Zillion while fitting the hand/forearm/body, without an oversized-rifle read. Both concept poses, all six body drawings and the target SMS pair are retained. No new anatomical or equipment-construction blocker was observed. Correct only the isolated navy source pixel at I00(105,99); then a content-bound narrow addendum is sufficient for that source cutout issue. Do not rerender bodies, reduce pose count, change timing for budget or add FX.

identity_and_face.note: Blue hair, youthful lean proportions, magenta uniform/scarf, white armor, navy harness/clasp/holster and face remain the established J.J. Body/costume comparison is to original concept only; updated gun authority is separate.

canonical_equipment_identity.note: Corrected concept now shows dark low-profile Zillion with a rear panel near grip, inset/angled accents and complete sloped front terminal. Source renders that family at substantially reduced, coherent scale. No white/orange compact blaster is reintroduced. Fine details become sparse in SMS, so exact target-size recognition remains an owner judgment.

pose_anatomy_and_joint_continuity.note: Both concept arm chains and all six source shoulder/elbow/cuff/wrist/hand junctions were inspected. New contact pixels seat on the existing hands without an observed disconnected wrist or unsupported grip. Sourcebody outside declared ROIs and lower body are preserved; preservation is not substituted for inspection of edited contact areas.

hand_weapon_attachment.note: Concept right hand wraps the underslung grip with an understandable trigger/upper-frame junction; lowered two-hand pose retains coherent thumb/palm contacts. Source aiming poses retain connected warm hand masses against dark grip/cuffs. SMS merges fingers/support-hand detail, but gun remains attached in both facings.

equipment_geometry.note: Gun-to-hand and gun-to-forearm relation is plausible in both concepts and all retained poses. Long receiver, sloping terminal and grip survive without an oversized barrel. S01 no longer presents the large length discrepancy seen in v2. No weapon/floor/boot penetration or truncated tip observed.

pixel_clusters.note: Source clothing/armor/hair form contiguous color groups; edited gun/grip edges are crisp. No broad grain/dither or whole-character texture defect justifies rerendering. The separate isolated background point is recorded under cutout B01.

face_detail_readability.note: Concept/source eyes and gaze remain intact; source face outside weapon ROI is unchanged and was visually checked near the gun. Target SMS has much less expression/finger detail; this is disclosed rather than presented as equal to concept expressivity.

outline_and_cutout.note: One source I00 navy pixel at(105,99),index2 has eight transparent neighbors and fails the official component-only min4/c8 check. Other five source poses pass that component check; fourteen SMS component passes do not close this source defect because the point is lost on reduction.

material_shading.note: Concept gun uses dark navy/bluegray and cyan rather than saturated blue/white toy receiver. Source and SMS preserve magenta cloth, neutral armor, warm skin and dark equipment. Fingers do not become gun panels and white remains on armor/face highlights as appropriate.

material_shadow_flow_coherence.note: Edited gun highlights follow its low hard frame; armor planes and cloth shadow groups stay coherent across preserved poses. Target reduction flattens the gun interior and some hair/face shading, but no blocking misplaced light cluster was identified in the changed hand/weapon regions.

semantic_palette_role_confinement.note: No shot, muzzleflash, sparks, trail or detached effect appears in the corrected character drawings. Source I00 isolated point is debris, not a justified object. Cyan gun accents are part of equipment. Social material mapping is restored independently and no longer turns34skin-shadow pixels magenta.

frame_pose_integrity.note: All six original source IDs/order and body poses are retained. Raw concept/source outside weapon/grip masks and lower source rows105..159 were independently verified. This establishes bounded edit preservation, not temporal quality or perfectly planted contact throughout playback.

native_size_readability.note: At SOURCE native size the Zillion is proportionate and visibly a dark long-profile pistol. At SMS size its direction/attachment/elongation survive, while internal panels and tip bevel become only a few pixels; S01/S02 receiver is especially dark. Do not infer exact equipment-detail perception or continuous readability from enlarged panels.

roster_harmony.note: Static pair remains stylistically coherent and visually distinct from Social. Independent index/RGBA comparison confirms all902visible Social pixels in both facings relative to pivots; only unused PLTE slots11/14/15 differ. No production-scale/body-height approval is inferred.

continuous_motion.note: Only still images were perceived. Proposed7/4/2/3/6, order and exact poses do not demonstrate intention, force, absorption, gun rigidity through motion, contact stability or recovery.
